item.title: Julian Araujo relishing opportunity to work under Wilfried Nancy at Celtic
item.description: Celtic loanee Julian Araujo has explained that the opportunity to work under Wilfried Nancy played a significant role in his decision to join the club from Bournemouth on a short-term deal… The Mexico defender has voiced belief in the Frenchman’s ability to succeed in the Scottish game, insisting early setbacks should not define Nancy’s tenure Read More
